name: real-health-juice-parlour-pos
description: Point of Sale system for Real Health Juice Parlour

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev
